title: Entomancer

moves.title: Pheromone Spit
effects: If PersonalHive < 3: Apply 1 PersonalHive, Apply 1 Strength

notes: Pheromone Spit has conditional scaling based on PersonalHive stacks. When PersonalHive is below 3 stacks, it applies 1 PersonalHive and 1 Strength, allowing the monster to build up stacks. Once PersonalHive reaches 3 or higher, it applies 2 Strength instead, preventing further Hive accumulation and transitioning to pure Strength scaling.
